szoveg_eredeti:
Exactly

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-19T04:12:49+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2123268230768939328; média: videó, 45 másodperc]
Elon Musk sets the record straight after years of being falsely accused of turning off Starlink to stop Ukraine's offensive strike against the Russian fleet in Sevastopol

Even Walter Isaacson acknowledged that his book got this crucial detail wrong

“And we've not turned off Starlink. This is false”

“At the time, the Starlink satellite beams were not on in Crimea”

Starlink coverage had never been activated over Crimea in the first place

Ukraine wanted SpaceX to activate that coverage for an offensive military operation against the Russian fleet

Elon refused, explaining that activating the beams would have required State Department approval because of sanctions

There's an enormous difference between shutting down an existing service and refusing to activate coverage that was never available

Yet Elon spent years being accused of doing exactly that

Walter Isaacson himself corrected the original account

Elon never turned off Starlink to stop the Sevastopol strike
